workItem: Classify pull requests from the complete attached GitHub label set while preserving unknown labels, surfacing contradictory metadata drift, and keeping labels non-authorizing.
workItemDE: Pull Requests anhand des vollständigen angehängten GitHub-Label-Sets klassifizieren, unbekannte Labels erhalten, widersprüchliche Metadaten als Drift sichtbar machen und Labels strikt nicht-autorisierend halten.

correlation.authorityOverlap: PR #1140 owns PR-template v1.7 files. This slice uses separate classifier/workflow/work-package paths and does not modify the open PR contract.

releaseCondition: Release on Human Owner merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
